questionEn: You are working with a geographically and time zone distributed team. It is important that the entire team always have access to the latest test execution information. Which of these is the most appropriate method for communicating that status?
questionVi: You are working with a geographically and time zone distributed team. It is important that the entire team always have access to the latest test execution information. Which of these is the most appropriate method for communicating that status?

options.en: A. Daily stand-up meetings with everyone
options.vi: A. Daily stand-up meetings with everyone

options.en: B. Dashboards connected to the test management and defect management systems that automatically update when a change is made
options.vi: B. Dashboards connected to the test management and defect management systems that automatically update when a change is made

options.en: C. Email sent out hourly to all team members with red text for any new issues with a “must read” note in the subject line
options.vi: C. Email sent out hourly to all team members with red text for any new issues with a “must read” note in the subject line

options.en: D. Formal test reports issued each week with trend charts and residual defect status information
options.vi: D. Formal test reports issued each week with trend charts and residual defect status information

correctEn: B. Dashboards connected to the test management and defect management systems that automatically update when a change is made
correctVi: B. Dashboards connected to the test management and defect management systems that automatically update when a change is made
explanation: Refer 5.3 Về Communication giữa 2 đội ngồi phân tán về địa lý và thời gian thì làm sao để họ cập nhật đc thông tin mới nhất của nhau thì chỉ có dashboard thôi ( giống như bảng chứng khoán nó update liên tục) Cau hoi 27

questionEn: Which of the following best describes the impact of poor defect management on software quality?
questionVi: Câu hỏi: Ảnh hưởng của việc quản lý lỗi kém là gì?

options.en: It ensures all defects are immediately fixed, improving software quality.
options.vi: It ensures all defects are immediately fixed, improving software quality.

options.en: Defects may go unaddressed or remain unresolved for longer periods, leading to delay to release.
options.vi: Defects may go unaddressed or remain unresolved for longer periods, leading to delay to release.

options.en: It reduces the number of defects found in the software.
options.vi: It reduces the number of defects found in the software.

options.en: It results in quicker releases with fewer defects.
options.vi: It results in quicker releases with fewer defects.

correctEn: Defects may go unaddressed or remain unresolved for longer periods, leading to delay to release.
correctVi: Defects may go unaddressed or remain unresolved for longer periods, leading to delay to release.
explanation: Câu hỏi: Ảnh hưởng của việc quản lý lỗi kém là gì? chỉ liên quan đến quản lý lỗi thôi nên loại A thì lại là quản lý lỗi tốt, loại C vì reduces the number of defects found ko liên quan đến quản lý lỗi, loại D vì mô tả đó là đang quản lý tốt. Chọn B thôi vì quản lý lỗi tồi thì lỗi ko đc sửa trong thời gian dài dẫn đến delay release Cau hoi 19

questionEn: Which of the following terms is used to describe the management of software components comprising an integrated system?
questionVi: Which of the following terms is used to describe the management of software components comprising an integrated system?

options.en: Configuration management
options.vi: Configuration management

options.en: Incident management
options.vi: Incident management

options.en: Test monitoring
options.vi: Test monitoring

options.en: Risk management
options.vi: Risk management

correctEn: Configuration management
correctVi: Configuration management
explanation: giải thích của họ: Incident management is the collection and processing of incidents raised when errors and defects are discovered. Test monitoring identifies the status of the testing activity on a continuous basis. Risk management identifies, analyses and mitigates risks to the project and the product. Configuration management is concerned with the management of changes to software components and their associated documentation and testware. Cau hoi 14
